messages.subject: Shiny server log with errors
parts:
Good morning,

I recently installed shiny-server on my machine. After I installed it I tried using the command "sudo start shiny-server" and an error was returned due to upstart. I then went to http://my_server_ip:3838/ and I was welcomed to the page saying shiny-server was installed. I followed the advice to look in the shiny server log that is stored in /var/log/shiny-server.log, and I found that in the file there were some errors, and warnings. Can anyone offer some advice as to where to go from here?

Thanks.
